card.name: Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan
card.skill:
[Double Strike]
[Permanent] If you have only 3 or less cards besides this card in your hand, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand or Battle Area by 4.
[Auto] When this card KO-s your opponent's Battle Card, inflict 2 damage to your opponent.

qa.q: When you have 3 or less cards in your hand, can you KO {BT2‐006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} with {BT1‐063 Son Goten, Family of Justice}’s auto skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
If the controller has 3 or less cards in their hand, the energy cost of {BT2‐006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} in the Battle Area becomes 2, so it can be KO-ed by {BT1‐063 Son Goten, Family of Justice}’s auto skill.

qa.q: {BT2‐006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} inflicted damage to the opponent with its auto skill. Does the owner of {BT2‐006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} choose which cards the opponent adds from the Life Area to their hand?
qa.a:
No, they do not.
The player who was damaged chooses which cards to add to their hand.

qa.q: If {Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} is attacked while it has [Revenge] and KOs your opponent’s Battle Card with [Revenge], can you use this card’s auto skill to deal damage to your opponent?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
{BT2-006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan}’s auto skill still activates when it KOs a card with one of its skills.

qa.q: If {BT2-006 Miraculous Comeback Ultimate Gohan} KOs a Battle Card with [Revenge], does its auto skill activate?

card.name: Zamasu, The Invincible
card.skill:
[Indestructible] (This card cannot be KO-ed by your opponent's card's skills or battle and does not leave the Battle Area)
[Permanent] If your Leader Card is <Zamasu> or <Goku Black>, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand or Battle Area by 1.

qa.q: When your leader is {BT2-036 Goku Black, The Bringer of Despair}, is {BT2-057 Zamasu, The Invincible}’s permanent skill valid?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
The character name of {BT2-036 Goku Black, The Bringer of Despair} is "Goku Black" so the condition specified on the card text is fulfilled.

qa.q: Can you choose a Battle Card with [Indestructible] as the target of｛BT1-065 Furious Yell Vegeta｝’s activate skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
In that case, the Battle Card with [Indestructible] is not KO-ed.

qa.q: Can you combo with a Battle Card in the Battle Area which has [Indestructible]?
What happens when you choose a Battle Card which had [Indestructible] with the opponent’s {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill?
qa.a: Cards with [Indestructible] do not leave the Battle Area due to your opponent’s skills.

qa.q: What happens when you choose a Battle Card which has [Indestructible] with your {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill?
qa.a: [Indestructible] is a skill which prevents a card from being KO-ed or removed from the Battle Area due to opponent effects, but not your own.

qa.q: Can you use a skill that gains control of an opponent’s Battle Card to gain control of an opponent’s Battle Card with [Indestructible]?
If your Battle Card with [Indestructible] has its power lowered to 0 or less by an opponent’s skill, is it placed in your Drop Area?
qa.a:
Yes, it is placed in your Drop Area.
Skills like [Indestructible] prevent cards from being removed from your Battle Area, but they still get placed in your Drop Area when an opponent’s skill reduces their power to zero or less. After you check to see if a card would be placed in the Drop Area by a skill, you then check to see if the card would be placed there by rules processing. The reason this is possible is because rules processing is what KOs cards in this instance, not the skill itself.
